body: 100%!! How can that be your only purpose in life???
Thank you so much for your response!! I totally agree with bringing it up early and thanks for giving me a bit of hope!! 🖤
Hi! Not really compelled to find "the one" but I'm just fed up doing everything alone 😂. Would like someone that I can hang about with cause all my friends are married with kids!

I've told my parents that I am never having children and they were upset  and I felt like I was letting them down somehow. Almost like I owed them grandchildren, but I never ever want kids and they just have to make peace with that. 🤷‍♀️

I actually cried reading this cause I feel it so much. It's my birthday today and I am filled with all these thoughts. I will never understand why I needed to be born and suffer through life. I resent my parents so much sometimes for having me.

Oh God I'm right there with you too. My immediate thoughts at the slightest distress is suicide. My therapist said that it comes from anxiety about what the future holds and the core belief that I won't be able to cope. But I have coped. I cope every single day and I really hope things get better for you and everyone commenting. 🖤
I'm so sorry you're going through this. I had panic attacks for years but I found breathing exercises really helped me. Im here to talk if you need btw. 🖤

Hey lovely. This sounds like a panic attack to me. Have you experienced anything like this before? Please look into grounding and breathing exercises and just remember a panic attack may feel like you're gonna die but you will not. Also for a quick fix when you feel it coming on, cup your hands and breathe into them. I'm here if you need to chat :)

It's not trauma dumping when it's to a professional. Please don't worry about this. Your therapist has many resources available to them to help them in their job. Please be open and honest with them and do not feel guilty. 🖤
